build_FeatureDictNet: build a FeatureDictNet wrapper to extract features from a PyTorch model at specified output indices
build_FeatureListNet: build a FeatureListNet wrapper to extract features as a list of tensors from a model
build_FeatureHookNet: build a FeatureHookNet wrapper to extract features using forward hooks without modifying the model
create_FeatureInfo: create a FeatureInfo object to manage feature metadata like channels, reduction, and module names
create_FeatureHooks: create a FeatureHooks helper to register and collect forward hooks on named model modules
